extensionName.message: Scam Guard - Phishing & Fake Website Detector
extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and stores

extensionDescription.message: Detects fake, phishing and scam websites before you enter your password, bank details or personal information. 100% free and private - everything runs in your browser, no data is ever sent to any server. Protects you from lookalike domains, homograph attacks, suspicious links and online fraud. Works on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Opera and Brave. Safe browsing, fraud protection and internet security for everyone.
